location_name: Western Railway Slow & Fast Tracks (Borivali-Malad), Malad Subway, SV Road
problem_description: Severe inundation at Western Railway Slow & Fast Tracks (Borivali-Malad), Malad Subway, SV Road resulting in complete light vehicle stoppage and transit diversion.
root_cause_hypothesis: Storm Drain Silt Clogging & Gravity Culvert Backflow
recommended_response: Dispatch appropriately rated dewatering pump set and traffic control personnel to affected waterlogging location, subject to on-site verification, resource availability, and authorized municipal approval.

suggested_resources.item: 50 HP High-Capacity Submersible Dewatering Pump Set
suggested_resources.note: Verify sump pit accessibility and power hookup before operation.

suggested_resources.item: Reflective Road Barricades & Caution Gantry Signs
suggested_resources.note: Deploy at SV Road North/South entry to prevent light motor vehicle ingress.

suggested_resources.item: Mumbai Traffic Police Wardens & MCGM SWD Response Crew
suggested_resources.note: Manual gating and traffic diversion towards New Link Road.

department: MCGM Storm Water Drains Dept & Mumbai Traffic Police
verification_steps: Step 1: On-site visual confirmation of water accumulation exceeding 45 cm before pump deployment.
Step 2: Inspect gravity box culvert manhole for physical silt/debris obstruction.
Step 3: Check electrical feeder isolation to eliminate stray current hazard before entering standing water.
Step 4: Verify that high tide backflow flap gates are functioning.
safety_considerations: CAUTION: Potential submerged electrical conduits near Western Railway underpass.
CAUTION: Open manhole suction risk under standing water; do not operate without safety tether.
SAFETY MANDATE: Strictly prohibit two-wheelers and auto-rickshaws from entering submerged section.
